document_kind: public view of frozen protocol; not the original frozen file
omitted_fields: program revision and historical review links
status_at_freeze: before first formal test trial; only dev results have been inspected
interpretation_rule: Report the paired estimate and interval without forcing a positive finding. A descriptive recall interval wholly above zero supports a benefit only within this dataset/protocol; intervals spanning zero are inconclusive, and resource tradeoffs are reported separately.

statistical_plan.unit: case mean across three repeats; equal weight per eligible case
statistical_plan.latency_percentiles: raw individual trials p50/p95; pair differences use case mean
statistical_plan.missing: unknown values remain null; all repeat values needed for complete paired case; report every failure and coverage
statistical_plan.negative_cases: recall/precision/MRR N/A; evaluate false memory selection separately
statistical_plan.ceiling: retain all directly relevant gold even when >5; report min(5,gold_count)/gold_count

execution_policy.queue: fixed seeded submission order, at most twelve native Harbor jobs in flight; each has an independent Docker environment and separate verifier
execution_policy.stop_rule: complete the full planned matrix irrespective of observed quality; retain infrastructure failures; any amended run must get a new protocol and output directory
execution_policy.cache: provider cache is not isolated; record reported cached and uncached tokens
execution_policy.latency: measured under twelve-way bounded concurrency, not isolated latency

scope_of_claim: Single user, single model alias and fixed historical corpus; model backend revision not supplied by provider.
Placement and discovery-index protocol are a joint treatment; not a pure directory-depth experiment.
The agent starts in a reconstructed memory workspace, not a complete historical code checkout.
QA and pre-task retrieval are separate tracks; no execution-success claim for original work requests.
Annotation and independent review were performed by AI agents, not a human gold panel.
Most queries have a common-root/unknown current scope; only six test cases have a known non-root scope.
None-arm recall zero is structural and cannot establish a hierarchy benefit over flat files.
Exposure markers/snippets do not prove comprehension or causal use; regex answer checks are narrow.
Snapshots use Git version time, not full historical replay; post-cutoff memories are absent.

concurrency_qualification.limitations: Observed container working-set peak is a lower bound; sampling gaps and VM/daemon/build overhead mean nominal headroom is not guaranteed. No further pressure expansion.

annotation_boundaries: Resume material is private when it contains sensitive data, not intrinsically because it is a resume.
The notes CLI/MCP gold applies to routing/contracts; its obsolete edges-note Skill pathname is not a required answer.
Generic AGENTS-to-Skill-to-CLI navigation is not gold for every task; concrete action-specific scope/CLI/task-writing constraints are included consistently.
